What happens after payment?

Gumroad provides access to your PDF after successful payment and sends a receipt email with an access link. Download the guide to read on screen or print the pages you need.

Can I print and fill in the worksheets?

Yes. They are designed for US Letter paper, 8.5 × 11 inches, and completed by hand. They are not interactive digital forms.

Is this suitable for a beginner?

The guide is written for beginners with a suitable workspace and helpers as needed. Check your actual materials with a sample table first. The compositions have not been physically validated for this edition; costs and results depend on suppliers, materials, and event conditions.
